name: Homeowner sends blurry/dark photo - AI asks for clearer photo
description: Homeowner sends a photo that is blurry or too dark for the AI to analyze properly. The image analysis indicates image quality issues and ANOTHER PHOTO is needed. AI should ask the customer for a clearer/better-lit photo.

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should arrive within 45 seconds (image analysis takes longer)
At least one assistant reply expected
AI should ask for a clearer or better-lit photo
AI should NOT generate a quote yet - wait for a better photo
